implementation_timing: Initial spec saved before data read; metadata mapping corrections made after field-name-only read; no computed estimates inspected
P_rule: Sensitivity only; replaces J, never concatenated with J

covariates.language1: factor(DR1LANG): English=1, Spanish=2, bilingual English/Spanish=3, other languages=4/5/6 pooled
covariates.proxy1: G/H DR1MNRSP; I/J/L DR1MRESP; valid non-self responses -> 1, self code 1 -> 0; 77/99/missing -> missing
covariates.proxy2: G/H DR2MNRSP; I/J/L DR2MRESP; same binary mapping

weights.A2: WTDRD1; age>=20, day1 reliable, not breastfed, DR1TKCAL>0, per whitepaper nonfasting definition
weights.B: WTDR2D/4; survey design on positive two-day weights, then adult reliable domain
weights.C: WTDR2D/5; survey design on positive two-day weights, then adult reliable complete-covariate domain
weights.single_PSU: Fail with error rather than silently change variance method

B.heterogeneity_model: svyglm(D ~ factor(cycle)), unadjusted cycle heterogeneity as specified in Stage B
B.heterogeneity_test: survey::regTermTest cycle, design-adjusted Wald F, model residual df
B.extrapolation: Expected mean D at midpoint 2022.7; 95% t CI using model residual df; not an individual prediction interval
B.reference_mean: Pooled WTDR2D/4 weighted control D mean
B.pass: At least one same primary endpoint has p>0.05 AND CI width < 2*abs(control D mean)

C.p_values: Two-sided survey t with residual df
C.control_cycle_SD: Sample SD (denominator 3) of four unadjusted survey-weighted control cycle D means
C.C1_pass: Same primary endpoint: both reference p<0.01 and same nonzero sign; main control-mean-reference abs(DiD)>2*control_cycle_SD; also report trend-reference size without adding a gate
C.C2_FDR: BH over the 10 control-mean-reference endpoint tests; C3 eligibility uses q<0.05 as contracted; trend-reference estimates reported separately without an extra selection threshold
C.C3_note: Contract C3(a) says add -DiD. This is frozen literally; under its definition -DiD=telephone-minus-in-person, removing that effect to recover an in-person counterfactual would algebraically add +DiD. Preserve this discrepancy and do not silently relabel the literal result as an in-person counterfactual.

missingness: No imputation or substitution; report eligible and outcome/model-complete person counts separately
stop_rule: Do not run B before A0-A3 pass; do not run C before B passes; preserve all results; no v1.1 rescue
